Abdoulaye Seck.note: Seck has already created a goal for Senegal in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Abdoulaye Seck.noteZh: 他已经参与了Senegal的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Antoine Mendy.note: Mendy gives Senegal cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Antoine Mendy.noteZh: 他是Senegal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Assane Diao.note: Diao is attacking depth for Senegal. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Assane Diao.noteZh: 他是Senegal前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Bamba Dieng.note: Dieng is the forward Senegal can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Bamba Dieng.noteZh: 他给Senegal替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.summary: Bara Sapoko Ndiaye is a Senegal central midfielder from Bayern Munich who gives the national team youthful ball carrying, midfield mobility, and long-term upside.
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye is midfield insurance for Senegal. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Bara Sapoko Ndiaye.noteZh: 他给Senegal一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Cherif Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye gives Senegal a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Cherif Ndiaye.noteZh: 他是Senegal在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Edouard Mendy.note: Mendy gives Senegal a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Edouard Mendy.noteZh: 他在Senegal首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

El Hadji Malick Diouf.note: Diouf is defensive rotation for Senegal. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
El Hadji Malick Diouf.noteZh: 他是Senegal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Habib Diarra.note: Diarra has already punished Iraq and Belgium for Senegal. The watch point is how little room he needs once the chance is alive.
Habib Diarra.noteZh: 他让Senegal拥有一个必须被惦记的得分点。每个松散球都可能突然变重。

Ibrahim Mbaye.note: Mbaye has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against France. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Ibrahim Mbaye.noteZh: 他已经为Senegal进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Idrissa Gueye.note: Gueye gives Senegal structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Idrissa Gueye.noteZh: 他给Senegal控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Iliman Ndiaye.note: Ndiaye has both scored and created for Senegal in this run. He matters because the same movement can become the shot or the pass before it.
Iliman Ndiaye.noteZh: 他在这段征程中既进球也创造机会。同一次跑动，可能变成射门，也可能变成射门前的一脚传球。

Ismail Jakobs.note: Jakobs gives Senegal defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Ismail Jakobs.noteZh: 他是Senegal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Ismaila Sarr.note: Sarr has put goals and service into Senegal's tournament, with finishes against Norway, Iraq, and Belgium. His card is the next action after the first touch.
Ismaila Sarr.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经同时给Senegal带来终结和传球。防守者不能只防他的一种选择。

Kalidou Koulibaly.note: Koulibaly gives Senegal another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Kalidou Koulibaly.noteZh: 他是Senegal在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Krepin Diatta.note: Diatta gives Senegal a front-line rhythm that keeps defenders facing their own goal. His value often starts before the ball reaches him.
Krepin Diatta.noteZh: 他给Senegal替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Lamine Camara.note: Camara has supplied one of Senegal's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Lamine Camara.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Senegal创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Mamadou Sarr.note: Sarr is the kind of defender Senegal can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Mamadou Sarr.noteZh: 他是Senegal艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Mory Diaw.note: Diaw is goalkeeper cover for Senegal. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Mory Diaw.noteZh: 他是Senegal门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Moussa Niakhate.note: Niakhaté has supplied one of Senegal's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Moussa Niakhate.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Senegal创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Nicolas Jackson.note: Jackson has already made a goal happen for Senegal. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Nicolas Jackson.noteZh: 他已经为Senegal送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Pape Gueye.note: Gueye has put goals and service into Senegal's tournament, with finishes against Iraq. His card is the next action after the first touch.
Pape Gueye.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经同时给Senegal带来终结和传球。防守者不能只防他的一种选择。

Pape Matar Sarr.note: Sarr is midfield insurance for Senegal. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Pape Matar Sarr.noteZh: 他给Senegal一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Pathe Ciss.note: Ciss gives Senegal a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Pathe Ciss.noteZh: 他是Senegal的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Sadio Mane.note: Mané has one tournament assist in the bank for Senegal. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Sadio Mane.noteZh: 他已经帮Senegal制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Yehvann Diouf.note: Diouf is goalkeeper cover for Senegal. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Yehvann Diouf.noteZh: 他是Senegal门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。
